observations.decision: LibreOffice conversion needs artifact plus semantic checks; exit code alone is insufficient, and revision structure is not roundtrip-identical.
The documented headless convert command cannot be a fail-closed package-validity gate: this build converts arbitrary non-ZIP bytes to PDF. Prevalidation and output semantic checks are mandatory.
A monolithic COM open/render/save/reopen probe is not a credible unattended hard gate; operations need isolated phases, watchdog process cleanup, and a logged-in desktop runner.

COM Open with OpenAndRepair=false rejected the three seeds in isolated runs, but DisplayAlerts=None still cannot reveal suppressed or silent repair. This is an open-error calibration, not repair-free evidence.
Word desktop automation is session-stateful and restart-fragile; release evidence must record runner/session health and quarantine the run after timeout rather than retrying in-place.
The prototype includes an AppleScript adapter, but save-as DOCX and PDF export remain unqualified until run on a licensed logged-in macOS Word host.
No claim about commentsExtensible/people roundtrip is allowed until a provenance-safe modern-comments fixture is supplied.
